title: auth_token.rs: unwrap on serde_json::to_value panics in handler
description:
Why this issue exists: serde_json::to_value() can fail if the type contains a non-string map key or other unserializable value. Calling .unwrap() on it inside an HTTP handler causes a process panic and crashes the server.

What needs to be done: In crates/mail/src/auth_token.rs lines ~68 and ~98, replace .unwrap() with .map_err(|e| internal_error(e)) or equivalent error propagation that returns a 500 response instead of panicking.
